01 / ABOUT IDENTITY

Perspective, Method & Mindset

Bridging vulnerability research, autonomous red-teaming agents, and systems-level architecture.

I’m a Computer Science student focused on cybersecurity, offensive security, and generative AI. I explore how systems break, how vulnerabilities can be discovered and analyzed, and how intelligent tooling can make security research more effective.

My work spans vulnerability research, reconnaissance, attack-surface analysis, AI-powered security tooling, and full-stack development. Rather than running generic scripts, I focus on the underlying architecture: how an API’s shadow routes leak state, how LLM reasoning loops can conduct deterministic exploit verification, and how predictive models can forecast multi-stage attack paths before defenses are breached.

Driven by a genuine curiosity for how systems break — and how intelligent tooling can accelerate the work of finding out, I actively build open-source tools, participate in 24-hour CTF competitions, and contribute to the Cysecsphere club at Chandigarh University.
